title: NEB Class 11 Mathematics — Algebra — 2021
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Factorise $2x^{3}-3x^{2}-10x+15$. Hence solve the equation $2x^{3}-3x^{2}-10x+15=0$.
questions.knowledgeNote: Factorising by grouping gives $(2x-3)(x^{2}-5)$; always split the difference of squares to get the linear factors.
